cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(EdgeFHE_V7 LANGUAGES CXX)
if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Linux only: use WSL for local tests")
endif()
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
find_package(OpenFHE 1.5.1 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)
option(EDGEFHE_SANITIZE "ASAN/UBSAN" OFF)
option(EDGEFHE_BUILD_TLS "Build native dynamic-input mTLS client" OFF)
add_library(edgefhe_os_prng SHARED os_prng.cpp)
target_include_directories(edgefhe_os_prng PRIVATE ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}/core)
add_library(edgefhe_v7 STATIC core.cpp secure.cpp)
set_target_properties(edgefhe_v7 PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(edgefhe_v7 PUBLIC .)
target_include_directories(edgefhe_v7 SYSTEM PUBLIC ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE} ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}/core ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}/pke ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}/binfhe ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}/third-party/include)
target_link_directories(edgefhe_v7 PUBLIC ${OpenFHE_LIBDIR})
target_link_libraries(edgefhe_v7 PUBLIC Threads::Threads ${OpenFHE_SHARED_LIBRARIES} OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX)
target_compile_definitions(edgefhe_v7 PUBLIC MATHBACKEND=4)
foreach(name legacy_selftest v7_selftest native_client export_hls_vectors)
  if(name STREQUAL "legacy_selftest")
    add_executable(${name} selftest.cpp)
  else()
    add_executable(${name} ${name}.cpp)
  endif()
  target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE edgefhe_v7)
  set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR}")
  target_link_options(${name} PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")
endforeach()
add_executable(queue_selftest queue_selftest.cpp)
target_link_libraries(queue_selftest PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
target_compile_options(queue_selftest PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
add_library(edgefhe_cloud SHARED cloud_api.cpp)
target_link_libraries(edgefhe_cloud PRIVATE edgefhe_v7)
set_target_properties(edgefhe_cloud PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR}")
target_link_options(edgefhe_cloud PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")
if(EDGEFHE_SANITIZE)
  foreach(target queue_selftest edgefhe_cloud)
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
    target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)
  endforeach()
endif()
if(EDGEFHE_BUILD_TLS)
  find_package(OpenSSL 3 REQUIRED)
  add_executable(tls_client tls_client.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(tls_client PRIVATE edgefhe_v7 OpenSSL::SSL OpenSSL::Crypto)
  target_compile_options(tls_client PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-fast-math)
  get_filename_component(EDGEFHE_SSL_LIBDIR "${OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIBRARY}" DIRECTORY)
  set_target_properties(tls_client PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR};${EDGEFHE_SSL_LIBDIR}")
  target_link_options(tls_client PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")
endif()
foreach(target edgefhe_v7 edgefhe_os_prng legacy_selftest v7_selftest native_client export_hls_vectors)
  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-fast-math)
  if(EDGEFHE_SANITIZE)
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
    target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)
  endif()
endforeach()
